label: StudySH-EP request manifest and frame SELECTION. CPU only on flash; no GPU, no model server, no inference, no frame rendered and none encoded: every frame is a row of StudyD14b's committed sha256 manifest, already in the D91 nexar q90 store.
header_count_rule: StudyD3's grey_header generalised: it names the realised frame count and the span. It CHANGES at every instant and sits FIRST in the prompt, so under this header no KV prefix of an append-only episode can ever be reused.
header_constant_rule: The following are consecutive dashcam frames, oldest first.
header_constant_note: count-free, so every instant of one episode shares a byte-identical text prefix and the growing frame list is a true KV prefix. Both headers are frozen per request; --header-mode picks one at run time and no manifest rebuild is needed.
negative_ref_rule: study_e9c_challenge.fake_event_times at seed 0, the committed matched reference; sigma is the sample sd (ddof=1) of time_of_event - duration / 2 over the 150 positives, the committed challenge rule
store_extension_note: instants below the committed 3.0 s D14b decision grid have no stored JPEG because encode_jpeg.iter_nexar walks the N = 1 rows only. Their PNGs ARE rendered (they are D14b N = 3 targets), so sh_ep_encode_extra.py adds exactly these files with the committed D91 recipe and touches no existing file.
